description.value: Smugglers Trail Caskworks is a craft brewery and kitchen in Langley, BC, founded in 2017 by two former rugby teammates who set out to bring quality cask-conditioned ales to the Fraser Valley. The spacious taproom features a covered heated patio that is dog-friendly year-round, and a full kitchen with dishes designed to pair with their rotating lineup of core, seasonal, and exclusive on-tap brews. Their award-winning beers—ranging from light lagers to stouts—are also available at local beer and wine stores across the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at smugglerstrailcask.com confirms an active brewery and kitchen at 9339 200a St Unit 140, Langley Twp, BC, matching OSM address and phone (778-705-1880). The site references 'order online for pick-up' supporting takeout, and describes a covered heated patio and full kitchen, but makes no mention of bike racks, Wi-Fi, washrooms, or water refill, so those remain null. The OSM name appends 'and Brewery' which does not appear anywhere in the website's own branding, flagged as a minor discrepancy.
concerns: OSM name is 'Smugglers Trail Caskworks and Brewery' but the website consistently brands the business as 'Smugglers Trail Caskworks' without 'and Brewery'.
OSM opening hours differ from hours shown on the website; website hours should be treated as more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active brewery and kitchen with a confirmed address, phone, and operating website. Clearly a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and craft beer in Langley.

wow_evidence: award-winning beers... available at local beer and wine stores across the region
